links.comparator_used: Original, unsimplified ACOG and UpToDate patient education materials
links.outcome: Readability (grade level across 8 formulas) of LLM-rewritten versions of existing patient education materials
links.effect: CoPilot and Gemini improved readability when prompted; none of the LLMs reached the sixth-grade benchmark; ChatGPT increased reading difficulty. Baseline: ACOG averaged ninth-grade and UpToDate 8.6-grade level.
links.tradeoff: ChatGPT increased reading difficulty. LLM text was shorter but used more difficult words (36.7% vs 27.4%), which may create an illusion of simplicity.
links.quote: Although CoPilot and Gemini improved readability when prompted, no large language model successfully reached the sixth-grade benchmark, and ChatGPT increased reading difficulty.

links.comparator_used: Original ACOG/UpToDate materials before the sixth-grade instruction (no default-prompt arm reported)
links.outcome: Whether prompting for a sixth-grade target reading level achieved that level
links.effect: Explicit sixth-grade prompting improved readability for CoPilot and Gemini but no LLM reached the sixth-grade level; ChatGPT became harder to read.
links.tradeoff: Explicit prompting did not guarantee target readability; ChatGPT output increased in difficulty. Readability safeguards are needed.
links.quote: Even when explicitly prompted, no large language model achieved the sixth-grade reading level required for optimal patient comprehension.
